title: Observability: token-level cost/latency metrics & dashboard enhancements
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add token-level cost and latency metrics, Grafana dashboards, and tuned alerts to improve surface area for tracing regressions and cost spikes. Motivation: customers and SREs need finer-grained insight into per-request token billing and per-token latency distributions (including KV cache hit/miss contributions) to diagnose quality vs cost tradeoffs and to tune Dedicated autoscaling. This PR introduces new Prometheus metrics (redwood_token_cost_tokens_total, redwood_token_latency_histogram_seconds with token_bucket labels, redwood_kv_cache_hits_total), a reusable dashboard JSON for Grafana showing token-cost breakdowns by model/route/customer, and updated alert rules with adjusted thresholds and multi-window evaluation to reduce noisy pages. Checklist: 1) Add backend instrumentation for token-level counters and histograms. 2) Expose KV cache hit/miss metrics and tag by shard/model. 3) Add Grafana dashboard JSON and dashboard provisioning entries. 4) Tune alert rules (cost-per-minute, p99 token latency, kv-cache-hit-rate) and add runbook links. 5) Update docs and changelog. 6) Add unit + integration tests for metrics formatting and ingestion. Related: ENG-7242 (dashboard for token cost), ENG-7330 (alert tuning after incident). No breaking API changes; dashboards are additive.
commits: feat(metrics): add token-level cost counters and latency histograms
feat(kv): emit kv_cache_hit/miss metrics with model/shard tags
chore(dashboards): add token cost/latency Grafana dashboard JSON
fix(alerts): tune cost and latency thresholds, add multi-window evaluation
docs: document token-level metrics and dashboard usage
test: add unit tests for metrics encoding and e2e ingestion
review_comments: Ben Carter: Can you confirm cardinality on model tags and ensure we don't explode series count? Suggest adding a model:version tag only when present.
Aisha Patel: Agree, we limit model tag to model_name and optional quantization_level; added shard dimension only for internal teams - documented in README.
Lina Zhou: Alert thresholds look good but can we add a noise suppression window for p99 latency so we don't page on bursty traffic?
Aisha Patel: Added multi-window eval (1m/10m/1h) and a suppression rule to require sustained deviation across two windows before firing.
Devon Harris: Tests look solid, added a suggestion to include a sample dashboard link in the runbook. Approved after minor doc tweak.
Ben Carter: Verified metrics ingestion on staging and ran Grafana dashboard provisioning. LGTM.
Auto CI: integration-tests flaked once (timeout on metrics ingestion), rerun succeeded.
release_notes: Add token-level cost and latency metrics, new Grafana dashboard for token cost/latency, KV cache hit/miss metrics, and tuned alerts to reduce noisy pages. Runbook links and docs updated. Deploy to staging then to production with standard observability release playbook.
notes: Follow-up tasks: (1) Roll out dashboard to Dedicated customers behind feature flag (ENG-7410). (2) Add sampling knobs for high-cardinality routes. (3) Evaluate storage/retention impact of token-level histograms after 2 weeks in prod.
